description: This file defines a RemoteConfigLoader class responsible for fetching and caching marketplace configuration data such as modes, MCPs, and skills from API endpoints, parsing YAML responses, and transforming data into MarketplaceItem objects.

classes.name: RemoteConfigLoader
classes.description: A class that loads, caches, and provides marketplace configuration items such as modes, MCPs, and skills from remote API endpoints.

methods.name: loadAllItems
methods.description: Fetches all marketplace items (modes, MCPs, skills), optionally hiding MCPs, and returns a combined list.

methods.name: fetchModes
methods.description: Fetches mode items from API, parses YAML, validates, and caches the result.

methods.name: fetchMcps
methods.description: Fetches MCP items from API, parses YAML, validates, and caches the result.

methods.name: fetchSkills
methods.description: Fetches skill items from API, parses YAML, transforms to MarketplaceItem format, and caches the result.

methods.name: fetchWithRetry
methods.description: Performs HTTP GET request with retries and exponential backoff.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Retrieves a specific marketplace item by id and type from cached or loaded data.

methods.name: getFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves data from cache if valid, otherwise null.

methods.name: setCache
methods.description: Stores data in cache with current timestamp.
